# Wealth Arrays

> Wealth Arrays is a browser-first financial calculator and financial education website. It provides transparent formulas, assumptions, worked examples, and practical money guides. Results are educational estimates, not personalized financial, tax, legal, or investment advice.

## Primary pages

- https://wealtharrays.com/ — Home and calculator library overview
- https://wealtharrays.com/tools — Full calculator library
- https://wealtharrays.com/articles — Financial education guides
- https://wealtharrays.com/about — Publisher, editorial ownership, and site purpose
- https://wealtharrays.com/methodology — Calculator formulas, assumptions, accuracy and limitations
- https://wealtharrays.com/editorial-policy — Originality, accuracy review and corrections policy
- https://wealtharrays.com/privacy — Privacy, analytics and advertising disclosures
- https://wealtharrays.com/advertising-policy — Advertising and editorial independence policy
- https://wealtharrays.com/disclaimer — Financial, tax and legal disclaimer
- https://wealtharrays.com/contact — Corrections and contact
- https://wealtharrays.com/faq — Frequently asked questions

## Editorial principles

- Prefer transparent mathematics over black-box financial claims.
- Distinguish assumptions from facts and projections from guarantees.
- Do not imply live FX conversion when currency selection only changes display formatting.
- Do not present the income-tax scenario tool as jurisdiction-specific tax software.
- Financial content should be independently useful even without advertising.
- Corrections should be reproducible from the exact inputs, formula and expected result.

## Machine-readable note

This file is supplemental documentation for AI systems and other tools that choose to consume it. It is not required for Google Search and is not intended to manipulate rankings. Normal robots.txt, sitemap, crawlability, indexing, content quality, and site reputation remain the primary discovery signals.
